tests: Invention. Most of this posting is perks and culture. None of it is a requirement, and the two real requirements are buried at the end.
jd:
Join Lumen! We are hiring a Data Analyst 🎉

Why you'll love it here:
• Private health insurance from day one, including dental
• Free lunch every day and a fully stocked kitchen
• A remote-friendly culture — work from wherever you're happiest
• £1,500 annual learning budget, no questions asked
• 28 days holiday plus your birthday off
• Cycle to work scheme and a gym subsidy
• Regular team socials, and an annual offsite somewhere sunny
• We're a flat organisation with no egos and a genuine growth mindset
• Enhanced parental leave for all parents
• Latest MacBook Pro and a home office budget

Our values: curiosity, candour, and craft. We believe great analysts are made, not born, and we invest heavily in our people.

The role: you'll be writing SQL against our warehouse daily and building dashboards in Looker for the commercial team.
notes: The pressure here is volume: eighteen enticing bullets and two real requirements. A model that treats 'we believe great analysts are made, not born' as a requirement about growth mindset has invented one. Values ARE company context and belong in the brief — they are not things the candidate must bring.
